paper.title: When Less is More: Approximating the Quantum Geometric Tensor with Block Structures
paper.authors: Ahmedeo Shokry, Alessandro Santini, Filippo Vicentini

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 16 sites · J = 1 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J = 1; no constant shift
results.variant: two-layer encoder, block-layer QGT natural gradient
results.source_location: Table "Summary of measurements for the chain L = 16 Heisenberg model" (tab:measurements), row "Block-layer QGT"
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy of the optimized ViT state with its Monte Carlo error, from the summary table of the chain benchmark; the variance is printed in the same table.
results.notes: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain of L = 16 sites with periodic boundaries (Sec. Heisenberg Chain), total energy. The text defines S = sigma/2, but the printed totals are on the Pauli scale (convention): -28.5685 lies below the lowest energy any S = 1/2 state of 16 bonds can have (-0.75 per bond, -12), and the exact S = 1/2 ground-state energy of the 16-site ring, -7.142296, is a quarter of -28.569185. Ketboard multiplies the energy by 0.25 and the variance by 0.0625. Two-layer ViT encoder. The magnetization sector is not stated.
